paragraphs.text: The Slivdrazi Monstrosity is a legendary Eldrazi Sliver from an unknown plane.

The Slivdrazi Monstrosity is an Eldrazi Sliver hybrid. It appears to have a large tail, two long stick-like legs, two humanoid hands, and a Sliver-like head. It combinates the attributes of Slivers and Eldrazi by making any Eldrazi into Slivers and Slivers into colorless creatures. It only appears on a playtest card making its existence likely non-canon to the normal timeline .
